audit_status.review_note: Military defeat, divine rejection language, tribal geography, Moab/Edom/Philistia, battle, and restoration.

notes.title: National defeat and lament
notes.body: Psalm 60 interprets military defeat within ancient Israelite theology. It is not a warrant to read modern wars as direct divine favor or rejection.

notes.title: Moab, Edom, Philistia
notes.body: These are ancient geopolitical enemies in royal war poetry. They must never be mapped onto modern ethnic, national, religious, or political populations.

translation_notes: This chapter completes corpus coverage as a ChatGPT-authored draft. KJV is retained as a familiar comparison layer; a separate automated reference pass adds BSB and pointed Hebrew without replacing the restored draft.
safety_note: Ancient war taunts and territorial claims are not modern political mandates. Never map these peoples onto living populations or use the psalm to justify war.
